items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Leonard contacted me a few years later and asked me to do this album, "The Tribute To Andy Razaff".

ctx.x: Also, by the way, since the first session that we had together, I talked with David Chertok. You know, he's the guy who goes around showing jazz films at the jazz festivals.
Yes. He's the only person I know that has a copy of that scene from Going Places -- that other picture that I made while I was out in Hollywood.
And I've never -- well, I saw a clipping of it in 1973 when I attended a jazz tribute to Louis Armstrong, with Leonard Feather and some others
